'''''Indomitable''''' was a [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class cruiser]]. It served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic's]] [[Home Fleet Strike Group Five/Legends|Home Fleet Strike Group Five]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and took great damage that reduced it to a mere shell by the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. It is unknown if the ship was repaired and returned to active duty following the battle.
